result.reason: The clause adds cyber/privacy coverage at the USD 2 million fallback and retains workers’ compensation, USD 1 million E&O, and certificates on request. However, it does not satisfy the required CGL structure because it states only USD 1 million of coverage and does not require a USD 2 million aggregate. The added cyber trigger is also less precise than the playbook’s defined Customer Data trigger, although it generally preserves the agreement’s commercial intent.
